evidence_quotes: Vergunning op grond van de Waterwet.
Eisers zijn geen belanghebbende omdat zij ter plaatse van hun perceel geen gevolgen van enige betekenis ondervinden.
rationale: This Dutch administrative court decision (RBMNE) explicitly concerns a permit granted under the Dutch Water Act ('Vergunning op grond van de Waterwet'), adjudicating whether the claimants qualify as interested parties ('belanghebbende') experiencing consequences of any significance at their parcel. Per the protocol, an explicit Waterwet permit challenge is substantively WATER under both labels and falls squarely within 'regulatory_permit'.
